integrity: Direct analytic derivation; finite Monte Carlo is diagnostic, not proof. Independent mathematical/historical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: For every fixed concave Lipschitz profile only: no uniform rate, no finite-thickness optimality, no unbounded-slope tips or second-order asymptotic. Historical priority is not exhaustively established. The thin-ellipse and thin-rectangle cases and classical Berwald inequality are prior work.
title: Sharp shape bounds and conditional tomography for acute triangles on collapsing convex lenses
